name: io.github.taher-el-mehdi/rdlc-mcp
description: Inspect and edit Microsoft RDLC report definitions: datasets, fields, parameters, tablix columns, page setup and validation.

rdlc_mcp_allowed_roots.description: Optional. Path-separated list of directories the server may open. Leave empty to allow any readable path.

rdlc_mcp_backups.description: Optional. Set to 'false' to disable the automatic timestamped backup taken before every write. Leave empty to keep backups on.

rdlc_mcp_backup_retention.description: Optional. How many backups to keep per report (default: 20). Leave empty for the default.
